source.title: Improved nine-node shell element MITC9i with reduced distortion sensitivity

statements.notes: The centre-Jacobian COVc substitution neglects the relative Jacobian and is not exact covariance.
The paper uses 3x3 integration and centre-co-basis sampling transformations.
Eight shifted serendipity functions plus a hierarchical central function.
Midside arc-length, central M1/M2, and symmetric-parabola alternatives are separately identified.
Penalty is the tested main branch; PL and deleted/scaled highest-mode branches are alternatives.
Only a small set of analytical fields and values is registered; no table or figure is reproduced.
Exact rational matrix arithmetic demonstrates reciprocity at fixed centre Jacobian and inequality to true off-centre covariant components.
Exact rational polynomial arithmetic checks all nine corrected functions.
Exact rational range bounds and rational square-root enclosures certify a selected nonlinear solve.
Exact monomial bookkeeping isolates xi^2 eta^2 and verifies its rigid-drill row sum.
Reported element performance is context only and does not classify the independent oracle.
